verdict.rationale: Groq's own platform documents image inputs via its Responses API, and its official TypeScript SDK shows audio transcription with whisper-large-v3-turbo through the same client. That gives developers vision and audio beyond text chat on one platform. missing for 10: image-generation models, dedicated vision-model documentation beyond a single line, text-to-speech/audio-output evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of multimodal use.
